vectors.description: Every condition holds, so the fire request is granted.
No heartbeat has been accepted yet; every other condition holds.
A reserved fault bit (INTERNAL) is set, injected; every other condition holds.
The device is in ZONE_SETUP; every other condition holds.
The head is not homed; every other condition holds.
Only the key is off; everything else would allow firing (live level, no key change seen).
The device is not armed; every other condition holds.
The latest heartbeat reports a person; every other condition holds.
No person now, but the clear period has only just started, so the re-engage delay has not elapsed.
The request arrives at 501 ms with a 500 ms lifetime issued at 0; all else holds.
The stored zone fails its checksum; every other condition holds.
Tilt 6000 is above the configured elevation limit 4000; every other condition holds.
The head points inside a stored zone; every other condition holds.
The request asks for 5001 ms, one more than per_shot_ms; every other condition holds.
A cooldown with 2000 ms left is running; every other condition holds.
A person is reported and the re-engage delay has not elapsed: the person is reported (rung 7 over rung 8).
The re-engage delay has not elapsed and the request has expired: the delay is reported (rung 8 over rung 9).
A cooldown is running and the key is off: KEY_OFF is reported, the cooldown is last (rung 5 over rung 14).
The re-engage delay has not elapsed and a cooldown is running: the delay is reported (rung 8 over rung 14).
A cooldown is running and the shot is too long: ON_TIME_LIMIT is reported (rung 13 over rung 14).
Three 5000 ms requests at 0, 10 s and 20 s are all granted (15 s of on-time in 25 s); no reply carries code 13.
A shot is running; a heartbeat reports a person: the effector is cut within 100 ms, the shot ends in COOLDOWN, the device stays armed, no fault.
After a person cut the person leaves and time passes: nothing fires by itself; only a new request, after the delay and cooldown, is granted.
Clear heartbeats stop for 500 ms with a hold-off of 300 ms: the status is stale (the heartbeat is not lost), so the request is denied PERSON_NOT_CLEAR and nothing else happens.
After a stale gap the clear period starts again at the next clear heartbeat (800): 1999 ms later the delay (2000) has not elapsed, at 2000 ms it has. The clear period before the gap does not count.
Before any heartbeat the request is denied HEARTBEAT_LOST (rung 1 first); after the first clear heartbeat it is denied PERSON_CLEAR_DELAY until the delay has passed.
A person was reported; clear heartbeats start at 0. One millisecond before the delay (5000) the request is denied; exactly at the delay it is granted (the heartbeat of that instant counts).
Clear from 0; a person is reported at 3000 and gone at 3200. The time before 3000 does not count: requests are denied until exactly 5000 ms after 3200.
With person_reengage_delay_ms 0 a request right after the first clear heartbeat is granted: PERSON_CLEAR_DELAY is never returned.
The head points inside a stored zone: the request is denied IN_ZONE_MARGIN and no fault is latched. After a MOVE outside the margin a new request is granted.
Tilt 6000 is above the configured limit 4000: denied ELEVATION_LIMIT with no fault. After a MOVE to tilt 3000 a new request is granted.
A shot is running and the head is moved into a zone margin: the effector is cut within 100 ms, the shot ends in COOLDOWN, still armed, no fault.
ttl_ms 500 and duration_ms 2000: the shot is not cut when the request's lifetime passes; it ends normally at 2000 ms. Nothing is cut with cause REQUEST_EXPIRED.
A shot is running and the tilt is moved beyond the elevation limit (inside the soft limit): cut within 100 ms, COOLDOWN, still armed, no fault.
No zones are stored: the store is valid and a request that passes everything else is granted.
A shot is running and the stored zone's bytes become corrupt: the effector is cut within 100 ms with cause ZONE_STORE_INVALID; COOLDOWN, still armed, no fault.
A corrupt store is invalid. In DISARMED, ZONE_CLEAR empties it (valid again); after ARM a request is granted.
Corrupt bytes do not repair themselves: after 10 s with heartbeats the request is still denied ZONE_STORE_INVALID.
While storage cannot be read the store counts as invalid (request denied); once it is readable again with matching checksums it is valid again, with no ZONE_CLEAR.
A shot is running and the storage becomes unreadable: the shot is cut with cause ZONE_STORE_INVALID.

The storage becomes unreadable and, while unreadable, the stored bytes are damaged. Readable again, the bytes still fail their checksums: denied. After DISARM, ZONE_CLEAR and ARM a new request is granted.
One long run (boot, homing, arm, a shot, a person cut, a zone denial, a corrupt store and ZONE_CLEAR, key off and on, heartbeat loss and recovery): bits 2 and 3 of the fault mask are never set.
duration_ms 499 and 0 (the old 'hold' value) are rejected FIELD_RANGE, not denied; the effector never comes on; a request with 500 is then granted.
The shortest shot, 500 ms, is granted and ends by itself at 500 ms with a normal end; no interlock event.
The longest shot, 5000 ms (per_shot_ms), is granted and ends by itself at 5000 ms with a normal end; no interlock event.
With per_shot_ms 3000 a request for 3001 ms is denied ON_TIME_LIMIT and nothing happens; a request for 3000 ms is granted.
750 ms is not a multiple of the dashboard's 500 ms step, but the device does not check the step: granted, and the shot ends at 750 ms.
A 1500 ms shot is still on at 1499 ms; at 1500 ms it ends with a normal end, the effector is off and the state is COOLDOWN; no interlock event.
A 500 ms shot ends at 500 ms: COOLDOWN with the effector off from 500 to 5499 ms, SCANNING again at 5500 ms (cooldown_ms 5000).
A shot ends normally at E = 500. A request 1 ms before E + cooldown_ms (5499) is denied COOLDOWN_ACTIVE; at exactly E + cooldown_ms (5500) it is granted.

Same boundary, but the shot starts at 5 ms and an expectation step at 253 ms shifts the device's tick times: the shot still ends at E = 505 and the cooldown is counted from E (denied at 5504, granted at 5505), not from the tick that noticed the end.
A person cuts a shot at 100 ms; the cooldown counts from the cut. The re-engage delay (1000) is long over by 5099, so only the cooldown fails then: denied COOLDOWN_ACTIVE at 5099, granted at 5100.
DISARM cuts a running shot at 1000 ms and starts the cooldown, which keeps running while DISARMED. After ARM, 1600 ms is still in the cooldown; 6000 ms is not.
A shot is cut by key off (SAFE_ERROR) and no cooldown starts: after key on and ARM the next request is granted.
A shot is cut by heartbeat loss (SAFE_ERROR at 1501 ms) and no cooldown starts: after the heartbeat returns and ARM the next request is granted.
From COOLDOWN with 3000 ms left, DISARM moves the device to DISARMED, armed false: the same as in any other state.
From COOLDOWN with 3000 ms left, key off moves it to SAFE_ERROR with fault KEY_OFF: the same as in any other state.
From COOLDOWN with 3000 ms left, heartbeat loss past the watchdog moves it to SAFE_ERROR with fault HEARTBEAT_LOST: the same as in any other state.
With cooldown_ms 0 the shot's end leaves COOLDOWN on the same tick: SCANNING at 500 ms and a request at 500 ms is granted; COOLDOWN_ACTIVE is never returned.
A person cuts a shot at 100 ms; the delay is 7000 ms and the cooldown 5000 ms, so at 4100 ms both conditions fail and the delay is reported (rung 8 over rung 14).

FIRE_STOP at 1200 ms ends a running shot: reply OK, event 'stopped by host', effector off, COOLDOWN, still armed, no fault, no cut and no interlock event; nothing happens at 5000. The cooldown is counted from the stop: denied at 6199, granted at 6200.
FIRE_STOP with no shot running: reply OK, nothing changes (no event, no cooldown); an immediate request is granted.
FIRE_STOP in BOOT: reply OK, nothing to stop, the state stays BOOT.
FIRE_STOP at 1000 ms during HOMING (3000 ms): reply OK and homing still completes at 3000 ms.
FIRE_STOP in DISARMED: reply OK, nothing changes.
FIRE_STOP in COOLDOWN with 3000 ms left: reply OK, the remaining time is unchanged (denied 1 ms before the original end, granted at it).
FIRE_STOP in SAFE_ERROR (key off): reply OK, the fault stays and the state stays SAFE_ERROR.
FIRE_STOP in the middle of a zone upload: reply OK, the state stays ZONE_SETUP, the upload continues and its commit succeeds.
FIRE_STOP at 4000 ms does not reset the upload idle timer: with the last upload message at 0 the upload is discarded at 5000 ms and the state is DISARMED at 5100 ms.
The same FIRE_STOP frame sent twice (sequence 1000): the second reply is the cached OK, there is exactly one 'stopped by host' event and the cooldown still counts from 1200 ms.
A FIRE_STOP with one payload byte is rejected BAD_LENGTH and the shot continues.
Key off in the middle of a zone upload: SAFE_ERROR with fault KEY_OFF, armed false, the upload is gone, the store is unchanged (the same as zone.setup.exit5.key_off).
Armed and scanning, the key is turned off: SAFE_ERROR (not DISARMED), armed false, fault KEY_OFF, and exactly one interlock count with cause KEY_OFF.
A granted shot is running and the key is turned off: the effector is cut with cause KEY_OFF within 100 ms and the state is SAFE_ERROR.
Key off while DISARMED gives the same result as when armed: SAFE_ERROR with fault KEY_OFF.
Boot with the key already off: homing completes and the device is DISARMED with no fault and no interlock count (the trigger is the change, not the level); ARM is rejected KEY_OFF.
After a key-off SAFE_ERROR, turning the key on with heartbeats continuing gives DISARMED, armed false, no fault; a fire request is denied NOT_ARMED.
The device never re-arms by itself: 5 s after recovery it is still DISARMED and not armed; only an ARM message arms it (then SCANNING).
A key-off SAFE_ERROR is not cleared by heartbeats alone: with the key still off the state stays SAFE_ERROR, a fire request is denied KEY_OFF and ARM is rejected KEY_OFF.
The key comes back on while another fault bit (INTERNAL, injected, it never clears in this feature) is set: the device stays in SAFE_ERROR and a fire request is denied FAULT_ACTIVE.
In SAFE_ERROR caused by key off, DISARM replies OK and the state stays SAFE_ERROR (the key is still off).
